summary: The DGA accordion: a stack of dga-accordion-item sections that open one at a time (single) or independently (multiple), for FAQs and long content split into sections.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: single closes the other items when the user opens one; multiple lets items open independently.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: The aria-level of every item heading, to fit the page outline.

slots.description: The dga-accordion-item elements, as direct content children (control flow such as @for is fine).

a11y: WAI-ARIA accordion pattern. Up and Down move focus between item headers (wrapping), Home and End jump to the first and last; disabled headers are skipped. Enter and Space toggle through the native header buttons. Block-direction keys, so the behaviour is the same in RTL and LTR.
